name: 53140 · Kenosha, WI
findings: ZIP 53140 (Kenosha) has 93 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53140 (Kenosha) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 7 arts and cultural organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
